title: Anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- anchor ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#4ad6ff" stroke-width="5"/>
  <!-- main shaft -->
  <rect x="45" y="24" width="10" height="46" rx="3" fill="#4ad6ff"/>
  <!-- stock (horizontal crossbar) -->
  <rect x="26" y="34" width="48" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ffd84a"/>
  <!-- top spike -->
  <polygon points="50,5 56,14 44,14" fill="#ff7a7a"/>
  <!-- bottom spike -->
  <polygon points="50,95 56,84 44,84" fill="#ff7a7a"/>
  <!-- left fluke curve -->
  <path d="M30 66 Q20 80 30 90 Q40 95 48 86" fill="none" stroke="#7dffa8" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- right fluke curve -->
  <path d="M70 66 Q80 80 70 90 Q60 95 52 86" fill="none" stroke="#7dffa8" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- left fluke tip -->
  <polygon points="22,88 32,92 26,96" fill="#7dffa8"/>
  <!-- right fluke tip -->
  <polygon points="78,88 68,92 74,96" fill="#7dffa8"/>
  <!-- shaft highlight -->
  <rect x="47" y="26" width="3" height="42" rx="1.5" fill="#aef4ff"/>
  <!-- stock end caps -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="38" r="5" fill="#ffb84a"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="38" r="5" fill="#ffb84a"/>
</svg>
